这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 HiDream 01 文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过此处使用的 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。

嗨梦科技梅建雄博士于2023年创立，梅建雄博士是中国著名人工智能研究员、前百度和金山专家，旨在创建用于设计和创意的先进生成式人工智能模型。 HiDream-O1-Image 开源模型于 2026 年 5 月 8 日刚刚发布。HiDream 01 架构充当多模态生成模型，可以解释自然语言文本提示并将其转换为高度详细的视觉资产。它利用深度扩散网络技术，根据指令的语义迭代地将随机噪声细化为结构化图像。通过分析大量配对文本和图像数据集，系统可以准确预测像素应对齐的位置，以匹配您所需的风格、构图和照明 影响。

您可以从 CivitAI 的 HuggingFace 和 LORA 下载此工作流程中使用的必要模型文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的其他工作流程：SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream E、Ernie Image、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、NoobAI、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B、Flux.1 Dev 和康定斯基 Image 5 Lite（T2I 和 I2I）型号。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 HiDream 01 模型文件，然后

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的 Kite 按钮。

所需文件

============

### HiDream 01 型号的下载链接 -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

此 HuggingFace 页面包含所有 HiDream 01 模型（基础和开发）文件。从 HiDream 01 一开始就设计，它的图像生成/编辑过程仅使用一个检查点文件中的任何一个。因此，您可以从此处下载并仅使用一个文件用于此工作流程。

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HiDream-O1-Image/tree/main/checkpoints

我在这个工作流程中使用了 HiDream 01 基础的 fp8 缩放安全张量文件 ( hidream_o1_image_fp8_scaled )，它非常适合任何 8GB VRAM GPU，如果您有 16 GB 或更高的 VRAM GPU，您可以使用更大的 bf16 文件。

另外，如果您知道如何修改 ComfyUI 工作流程，您可以使用任何外部提示增强器，如 ComfyUI 的基本和开发模型的默认示例所示，但为了简单起见，我选择不使用任何提示增强器。

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your HiDream 01 Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used here you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately.

HiDream.aiwas founded in 2023 by Dr. Mei Jianxiong, a prominent Chinese AI researcher and former expert at Baidu and Kingsoft, with the goal of creating advanced generative AI models for design and creativity. The HiDream-O1-Image open-source models were just released on May 8, 2026. The HiDream 01 architecture functions as a multimodal generative model that interprets natural language text prompts and translates them into highly detailed visual assets. It utilizes deep diffusion network technology to iteratively refine random noise into structured images based on the semantic meaning of your instructions. By analyzing vast datasets of paired text and imagery, the system predicts exactly where pixels should align to match your desired style, composition, and lighting effects.

You can download your necessary model file used in this workflow from HuggingFace and LORA from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream E, Ernie Image, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, NoobAI, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B, Flux.1 Dev and Kandinsky Image 5 Lite (T2I & I2I) models. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired HiDream 01 model files first and

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button.

Required Files

============

### Download Link for HiDream 01 models -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

This HuggingFace page has all the HiDream 01 model (base & dev) files. By design from very inception of HiDream 01, it's image generation/editing process uses just a single any of of these all in one checkpoint files.. so you may download and use just one file from here for this workflow.

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HiDream-O1-Image/tree/main/checkpoints

I have used the fp8 scaled safetensors file for the HiDream 01 base ( hidream_o1_image_fp8_scaled ) for this workflow which is perfect for any 8GB VRAM GPU, if you have 16 GB or higher VRAM GPU you may use the bigger bf16 file.

Also, You may use any external prompt enhancer like ComfyUI's default examples for base & dev models have shown if you know how to modify ComfyUI workflows, but for simplicity I opted not to use any prompt enhancer.
